description: A corporate controller must finalize the year-end accounting treatment for a litigation reserve, deciding how much to release, how much to retain, and what tax and disclosure controls to record, with input from legal and tax.

shared_context.S1: The company has a $3,000,000 litigation reserve on its year-end trial balance.
shared_context.S2: A draft close memo assumes the matter will cost $600,000 and proposes releasing $2,400,000 of the reserve.
shared_context.S3: Maya makes the final accounting decision for the year-end close.
shared_context.S4: As part of the reserve-release review, Maya conducts a routine round-robin check with legal and tax before posting the journal entry; each person discloses relevant updates, and Maya may finalize after hearing them without waiting for downstream action items to be completed.
shared_context.S5: Before posting the journal entry, Maya must state the complete reserve arithmetic: starting reserve minus release amount equals the resulting remaining balance.
shared_context.S6: Before finalizing, Maya must assign at least three separate post-review action items: one for legal document upload, one for tax memo circulation and disclosure work, and one for the journal entry posting.

PF1.text: A signed settlement term sheet received by Jonas this morning confirms a cash settlement cost of $1,800,000. For the $3,000,000 reserve, the reserve release is exactly $1,200,000 ($3,000,000 starting reserve minus the $1,800,000 settlement cost), leaving a remaining litigation reserve of exactly $1,800,000. The document has not yet been uploaded to the litigation file.

PF2.text: Elena received a tax memo this morning confirming that the $1,800,000 litigation settlement is nondeductible, requiring a $1,800,000 current-tax add-back and a related footnote disclosure; the memo has not yet been circulated to the close team.

acceptance_conditions: The reserve release must be exactly $1,200,000.
The remaining litigation reserve must be exactly $1,800,000.
The current-tax add-back must be exactly $1,800,000.
A tax footnote disclosure must be required.
The settlement accounting and tax disclosure actions must be recorded as commitments.

content_checks.C5: any('journal entry' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: decisions['current_tax_add_back_usd'] == 1800000 and decisions['tax_footnote_disclosure_required'] == True and any('tax memo' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The draft assumes a $600,000 settlement and a $2,400,000 release, while PF1 changes the settlement cost to exactly $1,800,000, which changes the reserve release to exactly $1,200,000 and the retained reserve to exactly $1,800,000, and requires a journal-entry commitment describing that $1,200,000 release.

The draft close memo specifies no tax add-back or tax footnote, while PF2 changes the current-tax add-back to exactly $1,800,000, requires the tax footnote disclosure, and requires a tax memo circulation commitment.
